newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END HIGHER AT 20.75/20.875 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END HIGHER AT 20.75/20.875 PCT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest ended slightly up on Friday at 20.75/21.875 percent as a combination of the passing of a tax payment deadline and the approaching end of the current reserve period spurred some banks to top up funds, dealers said.

"It was a very stable market - rates rose towards 21.00 percent in early trade but offers at that level saw no takers," said Erika Kaiser of Budapest Bank, adding that she did not expect rates to rise very much further on Monday.
"Rates could rise a little more as we approach Tuesday's end of the reserve period but I don't expect them to go above 21 percent," she said.
The National Bank of Hungary's one-week reverse repo rate currently stands at 21 percent.
